Name: Jesiah, Son of Uzziel
Summary: Second son of Uzziel in David's divisions.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 23:20; 1 Chronicles 24:24: Second son of Uzziel in David's divisions.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jesiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
